data.explanation: This is an invoice from your car repair shop for an inspection and new front brakes, totalling €642.30. The letter asks you to pick up the car and pay by the date shown. Note that a second, slightly later date is also printed near the bank details, so it is worth double-checking with the shop which one applies. Pay by bank transfer using the IBAN shown and the reference given, by the deadline. If you don't pay, the shop may send a reminder or charge late-payment interest, though the letter does not state a specific penalty.
